The project enters Form 8863 line 19 only when f8863.eligible (f8863.paid yes and sli.claimed no; married filing separately and nonresident aliens are refused for the whole return by s3.mfs and scope.other_income) and zero otherwise; the candidate copies line 19 on every return, so Form 8863 (its line 3 refusal sa.excluded_income, its Credit Limit Worksheet) is evaluated for filers who paid no education expenses. executable-triage-v2 (triage/s3.json; 1,306 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 120 partial records from 40 bases; 1,926 comparisons): 415 of 1,926 agree; 1,511 differ, 784 candidate-unknown (394 on completed returns) and 727 candidate-refuses, all on refused returns (classm.w2.1.deepseek; classm.f8889.4.deepseek, sa.excluded_income; classm.f4952.3.deepseek); no value differs. Traced (triage.py --explain 3 --witness 7, classm.s8812.4.deepseek, f8863.paid no, project $0.00): every candidate Form 8863 line is $0.00 up to Credit Limit Worksheet line 5, which reads the candidate's own Schedule 3 line 2 (the unguarded Form 2441 copy) and stops on $dcprov, so on the completed-return witnesses the unknown is inherited from the candidate's line 2; the candidate's own error on line 3 is that it asks Form 8863 of every filer and refuses excluded-income filers who claim no credit. Where both compute, the values agree: Form 8863's own zeros for an ineligible return (lines 1 and 10 choose f8863.zero) are not disputed.
